fixes.explanation: ELIJAH? Friend, I love the confidence, but nobody in this passage says that name. It's like yelling out who ate the last cookie before you even look at the crumbs. What the people begin to say is, "Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world." (John 6:14). They'd just seen the sign Jesus performed with those loaves and fish.

Sending a crowd that big home? I wouldn't want that job, friend. I can barely get a few people to leave my bakery when the cookies come out. But John 6:15 doesn't say Jesus sent anyone anywhere. It says He "…withdrew again to a mountain by Himself."
